name: Consolidated Server Data Pipeline
description: Maps the CHARESS Consolidé consolidated_db to FHIR with SQLMesh and routes it through OpenHIM — Patient identities to OpenCR, clinical to the SHR. DIRECT mode (default): SQLMesh runs on Consolidé and writes the fhir/sqlmesh/sqlmesh__fhir schemas there (no copy) — CONSOLIDATED_* is the write-capable user. Read-only fallback in docker-compose.sync.yml. PIPELINE_IMAGE defaults to the GHCR package; set it to sedish-fhir-pipeline:local to build locally.
